title: Scholarships and awards – University of Auckland
text:
School leaver scholarships for 2027 are now open!
In your final year of secondary school or kura and planning to enrol at University in 2027? You may be eligible for a scholarship!
Have a look
Types of scholarships
Find out about the scholarships available to suit different study levels and student background
Kimihia te roanga atu | Find out more
Am I  eligible for a scholarship?
We have scholarships for a range of criteria to help you fund your studies.
Tīkina ngā taipitopito | Get details
Learn how to apply for a scholarship
Each scholarship’s application process is different. Find out how to apply for a scholarship at the University of Auckland.
Me pēhea te tono | How to apply
Search for scholarships and awards
Our scholarships database is a comprehensive and up-to-date list of all the scholarships and awards available to future and current students
Rapua | Search
Undergraduate scholarships
If you are enrolled in an undergraduate degree at the University of Auckland, you can apply for a wide range of scholarships.
Tēnā tirohia | Check it out
Postgraduate scholarships
Students enrolled in or intending to enrol in postgraduate study are encouraged to apply for other scholarships.
He whakamārama atu anō | Learn more
Doctoral scholarships
Looking to fund your doctoral study? We have scholarships and awards to support your study.
Pānui tonu | Read more
What scholarships can international students apply for?
Live overseas and considering university study here in NZ? Or are you an International student already studying here? You may be eligible for a scholarship.
Kimihia te roanga atu | Find out more
Scholarships for students with disabilities
We have a range of scholarships and awards to assist students with disabilities, at both undergraduate and postgraduate level.
He whakamārama atu anō | Learn more
Applications open now
See which scholarships and awards are open for you to apply now.
Tono ināianei | Apply now
Scholarships news
Read the latest news related to scholarships, including information on new scholarships and other funding opportunities.
Homai he kōrero anō | Tell me more
AskAuckland
Your online help and support centre. Search our frequently asked questions.

Support for scholarship students
Information on scholarship payments and support available to help you keep your scholarship.
